column1: # Lalivero town: the wounded soldiers, Iodem's Black Orb briefing, and the ship.
# Wounded soldiers after the party reaches Lalivero.

column3: Is this more of\ntheir work?{end_now}
That voice... It's\nIodem...{end_wait}
You survived!{end_wait}
We lost men at the gate.\nThe rest could barely\nstand when it ended.{end_wait}
Were you fighting{pause_20_skippable} a\ngroup of six people?{end_wait}
There were...{pause_20_skippable} seven...{end_wait}
You survived as well!{end_wait}
Seven? Then someone\nwas traveling with\nthe six we followed.{end_wait}
I'm certain. One of\nthem must have been...\n{actor_name:7}.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7}, you say...\nIs that true?{end_wait}
Kraden was protecting\nher. I'm sure it was\n{actor_name:7}...{end_wait}
Did you hear that,\n{actor_name:1}? What do they\nwant with {actor_name:7}?{end_wait}
{actor_name:7}... They all...{end_wait}
They left us where we\nfell and headed toward\nBabi Lighthouse.{end_wait}
Why the lighthouse?\nWhat is there that\nthey need so badly?{end_wait}
They mentioned the ruins\nbeneath the lighthouse...\nThen they were gone.{end_wait}
The ruins beneath it?\nThen this was never\nabout the tower.{end_wait}
And Faran, master of\nLalivero, followed them\ninto the ruins...{end_wait}
Faran went after them?\nHe should not have\ngone alone.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! We must reach\nBabi Lighthouse as well.{end_wait}
Are you worried about\nthese soldiers?{end_wait}
We can still breathe.\nThat is enough. Go.\nFind the girl.{end_wait}
The lighthouse...\n{actor_name:7}... If anything\nhappens... Hurry...{end_wait}
Even they are urging\nus on, {actor_name:1}. Come on!{end_wait}
You forgot already,\n{actor_name:1}? Iodem asked\nus to wait.{end_wait}
We have to leave soon.\nBut Iodem asked to\nspeak with us first.{end_wait}
We can spare a moment.\nLet's hear what he\nhas to say.{end_wait}
Thank you for staying.\nI will be brief.{end_wait}
There is something\nI must ask you about\nLemuria.{end_wait}
The ancient island\nBabi searched for\nall his life.{end_wait}
You returned to Venus\nLighthouse without\nfinding {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
The lower passage\nwas flooded. We could\nnot get through.{end_wait}
But you looked out\nto sea, as Babi\nasked you to.{end_wait}
We saw a bank of mist\nfar out at sea. It\nnever seemed to move.{end_wait}
Babi told us Lemuria\nwas hidden behind\na wall of mist.{end_wait}
I cannot swear it\nwas Lemuria. But it\nmay be our only lead.{end_wait}
Then there may still\nbe hope for Babi...{end_wait}
...for his life?\nYes. If we find it.{end_wait}
Then we have to go.\nWe made him a promise.{end_now}
Good. I will see\nthat you have what\nyou need to sail.{end_wait}
Babi trusted you.\nI intend to honor\nthat trust.{end_wait}
We cannot leave\nwithout finding\n{actor_name:6} first.{end_wait}
I know. That is why\nI asked you to stay.\nTake this.{end_wait}
Iodem produces\nthe Black Orb.{end_wait}
The Black Orb?\nYou had it all along?{end_wait}
It controls Babi's\nship. Without it,\nyou cannot sail.{end_wait}
Take the ship.\nIt may help you\nfind {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
Thank you, Iodem.\nWe won't forget this.{end_wait}
Find your friend.\nBut remember Lemuria.\nBabi has little time.{end_wait}
We gave him our word.\nWe will find Lemuria\nif we can.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} got the Black\nOrb.{end_wait}
Babi's ship waits\nat the wharf. The guard\nwill let you through.{end_wait}
Go safely. If you\nfind Lemuria, bring\nword to Tolbi.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, we're really\ngoing to sea. I never\nthought we'd get here.{end_wait}
Then we should go\nbefore the storm comes.{end_wait}
We've waited enough.\nIt's time to leave.{end_wait}

column1: # The ship at Idejima was not Babi's.

column3: Babi's ship is here,\nat Lalivero's wharf.{end_wait}
Then the ship we saw\nat Idejima wasn't his.\nWas it Saturos's?{end_wait}
Perhaps. We have no\nway to ask him now.{end_wait}
Yes...{pause_20_skippable} Saturos and\nMenardi are both dead.{end_wait}
But Babi's ship is\nstill here. We can\nfinally cross the sea.{end_wait}
If {actor_name:6} is alive,\nwe may yet find her.{end_wait}
